article.title: Sony launches FX5 cinema camera with open gate recording
article.summary: Sony has launched the newest member of its compact cinema camera series in the form of the FX5. In another timeline, the FX5 may have just been an update to the Sony FX3 that launched in 2021, but in the current market it will be launching at a higher price, while the FX3 continues to be on sale. The FX5 launches with enough new toys to make the current and potential FX3 buyers jump ship. It has a new 16.6MP full-frame fully-stacked Exmor RS CMOS sensor along with a BIONZ XR2 processor with built-in AI processing. You can record up to 5K 60fps and 4K 120fps video right now, and 5K...
article.title_zh: Sony 推出具備開放式錄製的 FX5 電影攝影機
article.summary_zh: Sony 推出新款 FX5 緊湊型電影攝影機，定位為 FX3 的後繼產品，並以更高的價格上市。

article.title: Samsung chief explains why the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series is way cheaper in Korea
article.summary: TL;DR The launch prices of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Fold 8 in the US and Europe are far higher than the launch prices in Korea. Off to the side of the launch event, CEO TM Roh reportedly explained why the pricing is so much lower in the company’s home country. The executive described the Korean market as the “foundation for strengthening the Galaxy brand’s global competitiveness.” Yesterday, Samsung held its long-anticipated summer Galaxy Unpacked event, where it introduced the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series and Galaxy Z Flip 8 . While a price hike was expected, given the current state of the industry, it didn’t hurt any less to learn that we would be paying $100 more for the Fold 8 Ultra this year. What has taken some by surprise is the launch prices in South Korea, which are far more afford
article.title_zh: Samsung 首席執行官解釋為什麼 Galaxy Z Fold 8 系列在韓國便宜得多
article.summary_zh: Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra 和 Fold 8 在美國和歐洲的上市價格遠高於在韓國的上市價格。據報導，首席執行官 TM Roh 在發布會期間解釋了為什麼該公司在本國的定價要低得多。

article.title: OpenAI built support agents for its own customer service line, now it hopes big enterprises will trust them too
article.summary: The general consensus emerging across the AI and industrial spheres is that the models themselves are no longer the bottleneck — they are more than good enough to power deep conversations, produce vast swathes of production-grade code, and resolve all manner of customer support requests. The harder problem is everything wrapped around the models: the policies that decide what an agent can do on its own, the escalation path for when it can’t, and the record showing what happened when something goes wrong. article.title_zh: OpenAI 為自家客服構建支援 agent，現在希望大企業也能信任它們
article.summary_zh: AI 和工業領域的共識是模型本身已不再是瓶頸，足以支持深入對話、生成大量生產級代碼並解決各種客戶支援請求。

article.summary: Alphabet Inc. said its cloud computing unit had a $514 billion backlog of contracted work that hasn’t been recorded as revenue yet, signaling robust demand for its services that underpin the artificial intelligence boom.

article.title: Why Chip Engineers Should Care About AI-Created Behavioral Models
article.summary: You probably know this bottleneck too well: full transistor-level or physical simulations—whether analog circuit, electromagnetic, or thermal—can take weeks or even months. For complex designs, simulating every internal transistor in every block quickly becomes impractical. This is why creating accurate behavioral models is so important. A good behavioral model captures a block’s input-output behavior without carrying all the internal physics. It gives design teams a practical way to run more iterations, explore more tradeoffs, and save expensive golden simulations for the checkpoints that truly require full fidelity. article.title_zh: 為什麼晶片工程師應該關注 AI 生成的行為模型
article.summary_zh: 全電晶體級或物理模擬可能需要數週或數月，對複雜設計而言，模擬每個區塊的每個內部電晶體變得不切實際，因此創建準確的 AI 模型至關重要。

article.title: Google wants your face to be your backup password with new selfie video sign-in
article.summary: Credit: Joe Hindy / Android Authority TL;DR Google is introducing a new selfie video sign-in and account recovery method that lets users verify their identity with a short selfie video. The feature uses liveness checks, facial matching, encryption, and Google’s existing security systems to help prevent spoofing attempts. Users can delete their saved selfie video at any time and can choose whether or not Google can use their videos to improve its facial recognition and verification tech. Google is adding a new way for users to sign in and get back into their accounts when traditional recovery methods aren’t available. Called selfie video, the new feature allows users to record a short video of themselves and later use it to verify their identity when signing in to their Google account.
article.title_zh: Google 希望用您的臉作為備用密碼，推出新自拍影片登入
article.summary_zh: Google 推出新自拍影片登入和帳戶復原方法，使用者可用短自拍影片驗證身分，運用活體檢測、臉部辨識和加密等技術。

article.title: Runway launches AI model router as generative media gets crowded
article.summary: The Media Router is a tool that automatically selects the best image, video, or audio generation model for a request based on whether a developer prioritizes quality, speed or cost.
article.title_zh: Runway 推出 AI 模型路由器，應對生成媒體競爭加劇
article.summary_zh: Media Router 是一個工具，可根據開發人員對品質、速度或成本的優先順序，自動選擇最佳的圖像、影片或音頻生成模型。

article.title: Cursor, Ramp, and Meta are all building model routers — but two have major model ambitions themselves
article.summary: Cursor, the AI coding tool recently acquired by Elon Musk’s SpaceX in a $60 billion all-stock deal, has launched a model router designed to direct every coding request to whichever model handles it best, bypassing the need to pay frontier prices for work that doesn’t need it. Under the hood, the new Cursor Router uses a triage system à la a hospital emergency room: It looks at what a request actually needs — how hard it is, what it’s for, the surrounding code — and picks a model that is the best fit. A quick fix goes somewhere cheap, while a genuinely hard problem gets escalated to something closer to frontier-grade. article.title_zh: Cursor、Ramp 和 Meta 都在構建模型路由器 — 但其中兩家擁有重大模型野心
article.summary_zh: 最近被 Elon Musk 的 SpaceX 以 600 億美元全股票收購的 AI 編程工具 Cursor 推出了模型路由器，可將編程請求導向最適合的模型，避免為不需要頂級模型的工作支付高昂費用。

article.title: Charter bulks up on hotspot data, 4K streaming with 'Unlimited Plus Premium'
article.summary: Amid a move away from by-the-Gig plans, Charter has launched a new 'Unlimited Plus Premium' plan for Spectrum Mobile that features more hotspot data than its other unlimited plans.
